# CanaryIndex

> CanaryIndex answers which document-to-Markdown or transcription tool for AI agents actually works by publishing reproducible quality, cost, latency and raw evidence.

## Current answers (2026-10-05)

- As of 2026-10-05, CanaryIndex makes no public recommendation for Document to Markdown: no listed public tool has a current passing observation under method 1.0.0.
- As of 2026-10-05, CanaryIndex makes no public recommendation for Audio and video to text: no listed public tool has a current passing observation under method 1.0.0.

These statements are generated from: https://alidaram99.github.io/canaryindex/api/recommendations.json

## Agent endpoints

- Machine recommendations: https://alidaram99.github.io/canaryindex/api/recommendations.json
- Method and ranking rules: https://alidaram99.github.io/canaryindex/method/
- Method JSON: https://alidaram99.github.io/canaryindex/api/method.json
- Latest raw run: https://alidaram99.github.io/canaryindex/data/latest.json
- Repository: https://github.com/alidaram99/canaryindex

## Neutrality

Publisher-owned Drop-in APIs Actors are included and prominently labeled. Ownership, sponsorship and payment never improve rank. Private tools and tools without a current passing observation are excluded. A failed-to-observe result is not a product failure.
